description: I’m a proud Midwest mom and Northwest Indiana Realtor. Each day, I see families working hard to build a life, often against the odds. That’s what inspired me to run for Indiana State Senate District 6. I’m committed to fighting for real, practical solutions that put people at the center and help every family lay the foundation for a brighter tomorrow.
